title: 주말 내내 쉬었는데 왜 더 피곤할까? — 진짜 휴식의 비밀
es: Stop treating yourself like a smartphone. You are a plant.
videoTitle: Why Resting All Weekend Drains Your Energy
summary: 두 진행자가 중국어 강의(10/27)의 내용을 딥다이브로 파고들어요. 48시간 누워 있었는데 월요일에 트럭에 치인 듯 피곤한 역설을 《황제내경》의 'Sitting for a long time harms the muscles. Lying down for a long time harms the qi.'로 풀고, 림프계와 고인 늪 비유, 休(사람+나무)·仙(사람+산), 자동차 vs 스마트폰 비유, 그리고 '우리는 식물이다'까지 이야기해요.
topics: the ultimate modern paradox · hit by a truck · brain fog
Sitting for a long time harms the muscles. Lying down for a long time harms the qi.
Flowing water doesn't rot — stagnant swamp · lymphatic system
rest = person + tree · immortal = person + mountain
a car battery vs. a smartphone on a charging pad
구문: should be + -ing · not from A but from B · Even if… · What if…?

grammar.title: ① 피로를 생생하게 말하는 비유 표현

head: 표현
뜻

your brain is wrapped in a thick fog
머리가 짙은 안개에 싸인 듯 멍하다
like you just ran a marathon in your sleep

like you have a boulder on your chest

grammar.title: ② should be + -ing / should have — 기대했던 결과
grammar.lead: 논리상 그래야 하는데 현실은 반대일 때 써요.
examples: Your body should be overflowing with stockpiled energy by Monday.
월요일쯤엔 몸에 비축한 에너지가 넘쳐흘러야 해요.
My energy reserves should be skyrocketing. But instead, my body physically hurts.
에너지가 치솟아야 하는데, 오히려 몸이 실제로 아파요.
grammar.tip: But instead, … 로 반전을 이어 가는 패턴이 계속 나와요.

grammar.title: ③ not from A, but from B — A 때문이 아니라 B 때문에
grammar.lead: 원인을 바로잡을 때 쓰는 대조 구문이에요.
examples: They weaken not from overwork, but from severe physiological neglect.
과로 때문이 아니라 심각한 생리적 방치 때문에 약해져요.
You don't charge by shutting out the world. You charge by actively absorbing your environment.
세상을 차단해서가 아니라 주변을 적극적으로 흡수해서 충전해요.

grammar.title: ④ 원인 → 결과를 설명하는 동사
grammar.lead: 생리 현상을 설명할 때 자주 쓰는 동사예요.

grammar.title: ⑤ Even if… — ~라 하더라도
grammar.lead: 조건이 아무리 작아도 하라고 권할 때 써요.
examples: Even if it is just a tiny, imperfect patch of grass, go there.
It is perfectly okay to sleep in until 8 or 9. But once you wake up, you must leave the bed.
8~9시까지 늦잠은 괜찮아요. 하지만 일단 깨면 침대를 떠나야 해요.

grammar.title: ⑥ What if…? / it makes you wonder… — 생각거리 던지기
examples: What if those activities are actually the exact active meditations our bodies need?
그런 활동이 사실 우리 몸에 필요한 '움직이는 명상'이라면요?
It makes you wonder what other activities we currently classify as chores.
지금 집안일로 분류하는 다른 활동들은 어떨지 궁금해져요.

quiz.q: What is 'the ultimate modern paradox' in this episode?
options: Resting all weekend leaves you more exhausted.
quiz.explain: You're somehow more exhausted than you were on Friday afternoon.

quiz.q: What does the 8-character warning say about sitting?
quiz.explain: Sitting for a long time harms the muscles.

quiz.q: According to the hosts, sitting all day doesn't strain our muscles, but…
quiz.explain: We aren't straining them. No, but we are absolutely starving them.

quiz.q: In traditional Chinese medicine, qi is…
options: just the air in your lungs
your life energy and metabolic driving force
quiz.explain: It is your life energy, your vitality, and your fundamental metabolic driving force.

quiz.q: Why is the lymphatic system mentioned?
options: It has its own pump, the heart.
It relies on muscle movement, so it stagnates when we lie still.
It works best when we sleep 15 hours.
quiz.explain: It relies entirely on the physical contraction of your skeletal muscles.

quiz.q: 'Flowing water doesn't rot' compares stillness to…
quiz.explain: If you don't move, your energy stagnates just like that swamp water.

options: a person lying on a mat
a person leaning against a tree
quiz.explain: The literal visual definition of true rest is a person leaning against a large living tree.

quiz.q: What happens after a 20-minute walk in a park, according to research?
quiz.explain: Their cortisol levels, the primary stress hormone, noticeably drop.

quiz.q: Why doesn't a car parked for 6 weeks start?
options: The battery dies from lack of use.
quiz.explain: The battery goes completely dead from lack of use. Movement creates the energy.

quiz.q: 'You hit the nail on the head.' means…
What is the advice for the weekend?
options: Sleep in if needed, but leave the bed once you wake up.
Stay in bed to save energy.
quiz.explain: It is perfectly okay to sleep in until 8 or 9… But once you wake up, you must physically leave the bed.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: 'They weaken not from overwork, ___ from severe physiological neglect.'
quiz.explain: not from A, but from B.
